title: surge.t1 puts a prose comment before the version tag, displacing 't1 1' from the established first-line manifest layout
evidence:
+# t1 manifest — per-tick FNV-1a-64 state hashes (full sim state)
+t1 1
+demo surge
+seed 4243
+logic_hz 20
+catalog_hash 8da858ab04b113db
+ticks 4000
detail: In this manifest the 't1 1' version tag sits on line 2 behind a comment; the established layout elsewhere anchors it as the file's first line. Any positional manifest reader (drift-check, replay gate, compare tooling) must skip comment lines to parse surge.t1.
recommended_fix: Either emit the comment after the 't1 1' version line, or confirm and document that every manifest consumer skips leading '#' comment lines.
